Info

Dedicated handler translating mouse pan events into canvas viewport offsets.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.canvas.handler.pan.canvas_viewport_pan_handler.CanvasViewportPanHandler(vp: ViewportTransform, state: CanvasInteractionState)[source]¶

Bases: object

Handles mouse button press, drag, and release for viewport panning.

It defines:

attributes:
_vp - Viewport transformation matrix.
_state - Interactive mouse pan, drag, and selection state.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes pan handler with viewport and state.
try_start_pan - Checks event and initiates viewport panning.
pan_drag - Translates viewport offsets during active drag.
stop_pan - Terminates active viewport panning on release.
is_panning - Queries active panning state.
_state: CanvasInteractionState¶
_vp: ViewportTransform¶
is_panning() → bool[source]¶

Queries active panning state.

Returns:

True if currently panning, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.

pan_drag(event_x: int, event_y: int) → bool[source]¶

Translates viewport offsets during active mouse drag.

Parameters:

  • event_x – Current mouse X pixel coordinate.

  • event_y – Current mouse Y pixel coordinate.

Returns:

True if viewport offset was modified, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.

stop_pan() → bool[source]¶

Terminates active viewport panning on mouse release.

Returns:

True if panning was terminated, False if not panning.

Exceptions:

None.

try_start_pan(event: Event) → bool[source]¶

Checks event and initiates panning if button 2 or 3 is pressed.

Parameters:

event – Tkinter mouse Event.

Returns:

True if panning was initiated, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.
